name: Baldo Baldo
source:
He is a magician living in Amidahara.
He used to be an elite officer of a secret research institute of the German military, which was enthusiastic about research on the magical world, and was in charge of magical research.

He is said to be the third most powerful magician in Amidahara, and his abilities are well documented.
His nickname is "Baron".
As the owner of the abandoned district called Nakanoshima, he is an eccentric who lives in a tall building that has been remodeled to look like a tower.
